info.name: Trance
info.description: Psytrance: a rolling bass under a phrygian riff, as a whole song.

songs.name: Psytrance
songs.description: A psytrance song in E phrygian at 145 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, drive, break, climax and outro on the four Psytrance patterns. The bass's filter opens over the intro; in the drive the open hats come in after four measures and the riff after eight; kick and bass drop out for the last two beats before the break, the riff's filter opens over the break and its echo runs away into the climax; the climax throws the riff's last beat into the echo at the end of each phrase, and over the outro the bass fades out.

patterns.name: Psytrance Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the Psytrance demo, 4 measures in E phrygian at 145 BPM, all synth sounds: a punchy kick on every beat, the rolling bass on the three 16ths after it (ducked by the kick, an octave jump at the end of measure 2, F and G at the end of measure 4), 909 hats and a shaker.

patterns.name: Psytrance Drive
patterns.description: The main part of the Psytrance demo, 4 measures in E phrygian at 145 BPM: kick and rolling bass, a clap on 2 and 4, hats, open hats and shaker, and a resonant saw riff in 16ths in ping-pong delay, its filter on a slow LFO.

patterns.name: Psytrance Break
patterns.description: The break of the Psytrance demo, 4 measures in E phrygian: no kick and no bass, a sweeping pad on E minor then F major, the saw riff over it and a snare roll in 8ths then 16ths over the last two measures.

patterns.name: Psytrance Climax
patterns.description: The climax of the Psytrance demo, 4 measures in E phrygian at 145 BPM: the drive with a crash on the first beat, a ride on the off-beats, the riff an octave up, an off-beat bell arpeggio and the pad low underneath.
